About Akrostech

Built to power your growth.

We exist so ambitious companies can scale operations without scaling overhead — with dedicated teams that feel in-house, work your hours and answer to your goals.

Meet the team

Our story

Why we chose your clock.

Akrostech is a backend operations partner that provides web development, recruitment assistance, virtual assistance, accounting assistance and legal assistance to growing companies in the USA, Europe, Australia and the Middle East. Its dedicated teams work during each client’s local business hours.

  1. 01 — The gap

    Two bad options.

    Growing companies kept telling us the same story. When operations outgrew their team, they could pay a consultancy premium rates for slide decks and junior staff, or gamble on freelancers who vanished mid-project and never overlapped with their working day. Neither option was built for companies that simply needed reliable, skilled people doing the work — every day.

  2. 02 — The decision

    So we built the middle ground.

    Akrostech was founded to be the partner we wished existed: dedicated, vetted specialists, managed properly, priced transparently and aligned to our clients’ hours rather than our own. We flipped the clock, so our teams start their day when yours does — in New York, London, Dubai or Sydney.

  3. 03 — Today

    One partner. Five pillars.

    Today our engineers, recruiters, assistants, accountants and legal professionals run the backend operations of companies across four regions. The promise hasn’t changed since day one: we show up when you do, we own the outcome, and we make your team bigger without making your org chart heavier.

Mission

Give growing companies world-class operational support — in their hours, without the cost and delay of traditional hiring.

Vision

A world where any business can build a brilliant team, regardless of borders, time zones or headcount budgets.

What we stand for

Five values. Zero fine print.

These aren’t posters on a wall. They decide how we price, how we hire and what happens when something goes wrong.

Radical transparency

Clear pricing, honest timelines and reporting you can see. If something slips, you hear it from us first.

Operational excellence

Documented playbooks, measured quality and continuous improvement in every engagement.

People first

Fair schedules, real careers and genuine wellbeing support — rested people do better work for you.

Relentless reliability

We show up when you do, every day. Backups, cover plans and NDAs are standard, not upsells.

Innovation always

We adopt better tools and automation early, and pass the efficiency gains straight to you.

Leadership

The people behind the operations.

Operators, engineers and specialists who have run the same functions they now run for you.
